method: Sequential single-run development-profile benchmarks using bundled pinned Gemma 3 1B Q4_K_M and actual 0361/0362 XRKs; analysis+parsing outside service wall. Baseline CPU sandbox disables access to Metal; baseline CPU wall includes a failed Metal attempt before CPU fallback; explicit --cpu after build disables model/KV/operation offload outside sandbox. Metal runs outside sandbox with native 27/27-layer logs. No simultaneous inference. Background test/build activity and thermal state are not controlled.
phaseTimingCaveat: Baseline phase timers precede explicit llama context synchronization; optimized timing includes synchronization. Wall latency is authoritative.
gpuUtilizationLimitation: GPU utilization counters require privileged platform profiling unavailable here; offload is verified by device registration and native 27/27-layer logs.
buildProfile: Rust dev; native llama.cpp RelWithDebInfo (-O2 -g -DNDEBUG), embedded Metal library enabled. No full Rust release or packaging build performed.

experimentDecisions.shortRequestLocalIds: accepted: exact original recommendations and report preserved
experimentDecisions.positionalHypothesisArray: rejected: third recommendation degraded to generic calibration in all workloads

explanations.action: Hold approach speed repeatable and try opening the exit arc earlier, then build acceleration smoothly.
explanations.hypothesis: The exit arc may delay speed recovery; lower entry momentum could also explain the deficit.
explanations.validation: Compare distance to recover speed after the minimum, exit speed, and corner-plus-following time.

explanations.action: Keep entry speed repeatable and test a smoother arc through minimum speed; preserve the exit before increasing entry speed.

explanations.validation: Compare minimum speed and its location, then verify exit speed and corner-plus-following time.
